scene: seven escargots in herb-garlic butter in the wells of a metal escargot plate; a water bottle and a glass of an unreadable dark drink behind
notes: Seven identical units served as ONE dish: the merge rule and the count have to hold at the same time — one fish serving, count seven, not seven servings and not one unit. Snails take the seafood group for the same reason the existing mixed-seafood case does. The butter pooled in the wells is a real item and is the thing most likely to be dropped. The bottle behind is water and the dark glass is not readable; this is NOT a bottle-and-glass case and nothing about drinks should be scored here.
